[sqlite.schema] objects=8
-- index idx_restore_attempts_open
CREATE INDEX idx_restore_attempts_open
          ON restore_attempts(outcome) WHERE outcome IS NULL
-- index idx_sessions_project
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_project
          ON sessions(project_path)
-- index idx_sessions_tmux_name
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_tmux_name
          ON sessions(tmux_name)
-- table meta
CREATE TABLE meta (
       key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
       value TEXT NOT NULL
     )
-- table migrations
CREATE TABLE migrations (
      id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      name       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      applied_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    )
-- table projects
CREATE TABLE projects (
          id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
          path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
          name TEXT NOT NULL
        )
-- table restore_attempts
CREATE TABLE restore_attempts (
          id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
          session_id TEXT    NOT NULL,
          started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
          -- Filled the instant tmux new-session returns. NULL means no
          -- session was created, or Tortie stopped before it could be
          -- recorded, and only tmux can say which.
          tmux_id     TEXT,
          -- NULL means the attempt never finished. Otherwise a
          -- RestoreResultKind.
          outcome     TEXT,
          finished_at INTEGER
        )
-- table sessions
CREATE TABLE sessions (
          id               TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
          name             TEXT NOT NULL,
          tmux_name        TEXT NOT NULL,
          project_path     TEXT NOT NULL,
          cwd              TEXT NOT NULL,
          agent            TEXT NOT NULL,
          agent_session_id TEXT,
          argv             TEXT NOT NULL,
          resume_argv      TEXT,
          env              TEXT,
          status           TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running',
          created_at       INTEGER NOT NULL,
          last_seen        INTEGER NOT NULL
        , exit_code INTEGER, exit_signal TEXT, pane_pid INTEGER, resume_capture TEXT, specstory TEXT, restore TEXT, agent_version TEXT, agent_contract TEXT, resume_provenance TEXT, context_snapshot TEXT, removed_at INTEGER, env_passthrough TEXT, exit_detail TEXT, machine_id TEXT, machine_tombstone TEXT)
